chunks: Those who conceal any part of the Scriptures that God has revealed, and thus make a little profit thereby, take nothing but fire as food; and God will not turn to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor nourish them for growth; and their doom will be painful.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for concealing divine revelation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse specifically targets the Ahl al-Sunnah for concealing prophetic traditions regarding the designation of Imam Ali at Ghadir Khumm to secure political legitimacy. It underscores the gravity of withholding divine knowledge, portraying the concealment not merely as an omission but as a transactional betrayal that results in divine silence and a painful punishment on the Day of Resurrection.
